reviews.text: They're thieves, they overcharge and don't even do the job. They pretend they forgot to clean the dog and charged me an arm and a leg, and all they say is that I should come back for a refund.
Great place, they always take good care of my dog ​​and detect any problems in time.

I highly recommend this daycare and hotel. Excellent care and professional staff. The dogs are always under supervision. They treat them very well.
I love them, they are truly amazing, highly recommend them ♡❤️
It was our first time visiting and we loved the service from the staff; we will definitely be back.

Vivian provided excellent service. We came from Satélite, then went to Prado and didn't like it due to poor service. We met Vivian in Polanco and received very good service from all the staff... 🫥🫥🥰 …

NEGLIGENT AND INCOMPETENT. They bathed my dog ​​and left cotton balls in her ears. She spent a whole day shaking her head until I discovered they hadn't removed them. I had to take them out myself, but she almost got infected. When I told them what they had done, they blocked me and didn't apologize. Bunch of incompetent and irresponsible people. NEVER GO THERE.
My pet is great, they just took too long. But overall very satisfied
Exorbitant prices for poor service that is often slow and unprofessional. The area urgently needs competition.
I've always loved Pet Society for shopping and the service, especially Brenda, who is very nice.
Don't go there! They'll hurt your dog!!"
Not much for cats. And their pet hotel is dogs only. But it's a cute spot

I left my dog ​​at the hotel for a few days, and they returned her with a broken leg and refused to cover the vet bills. They also didn't want my brother to see her when they told me about the broken leg, which was very strange.
They're wonderful hosts to our furry friends. Excellent service and a great selection in store.

This business puts your dogs in an adjacent house on the next street over (Emilio Castelar) where they'll spend the day suffering and barking incessantly.
We live in the building that overlooks the adjoining courtyard, and it's a real nightmare to hear the dogs barking from 6 a.m. until night. Don't take your dogs there, because they'll only suffer.
This place is not suitable for keeping dogs.
The neighbors and the restaurants below the business are preparing a joint complaint to the local council and the police.

Abusive, thieves! They charged me "medium" for a bath and brushing for a 1.5kg dog. Their justification was that they've always charged me that way! (I'd never noticed before.) No manager or supervisor wanted to or could tell me why they considered a 1.5kg dog medium. They just said that's how they'd always charged me, and that's how they had to charge me, even though my dog ​​was small.
I highly recommend it. Go early to make the most of a Sunday and walk around the area with your pet when it's out, or you can wait and have breakfast at Bandido, just a block away.
I love their service
My friend's dog ran away, and when she contacted them, they didn't even bother to notify her. Imagine if your dog ran away and they didn't even tell you. 0 stars

I've been taking my dog ​​there for several years. I like that his bath and grooming are visible, and they do a good job. I just recommend checking that they've done the requested service (for example, checking if they trimmed his nails if you asked for it, or that his coat is dry). I have had to ask them to do it a couple of times, but I don't think it's because they're trying to scam me; it's just that with so many services, they might miss something. But if you mention it, they do it right away without any problem.

Three times in a row they forgot to cut my dog's hair and only bathed him. Twice they apologized. The third time I didn't go back. They're probably ripping off the owners because the numbers don't add up.

This is the second time this has happened: I bring my toy poodle in for a haircut and they just give her a little brush and don't actually cut her hair. When I pick her up, they tell me to bring her back the next day. I don't know why, but I'm not going back this time.
Be careful they mistreat the animals and they recently lost one.
Bartolo, a little dog who was staying at a boarding facility, was lost here. It's a place where animals are mistreated. Check the comments on their Facebook page.
Bartolo, a small dog, escaped this morning. A post was made on Facebook, but he hasn't been found yet. Be careful with this company if you value the lives of your pets.

I've been taking my dog ​​there for years, and honestly, I always prefer the Naples location because they treat the dogs wonderfully. Today, due to time constraints and distance, I took him to the Polanco location, and it was a horrible experience. It took almost four hours to bathe him, and when they finally came to pick him up two hours later, he was still wet and abandoned in the tub. Then they said he bit someone (by the way, my dog ​​has never bitten anyone in his life), but when the person he supposedly bit approachs him, my dog ​​gets agitated. Then he shows us the bite, and honestly, what nerve! That was a human bite. (If you hire someone to bathe dogs, at least make sure they have a genuine love for them.) Then I saw another large dog there being handled horribly and mistreated.
We will never return to this Pet Society. I highly recommend the Naples or Palmas locations; they are a thousand times better.
They close earlier than it says here. We ran for nothing to get there.
It's always closed
Arrived at the store and it is closed , 6pm Saturday
Terrible service, it's a shame how they're burying themselves because of their poor service
Good service overall. Just a little slow.
The service has improved a lot.
They don't respect the schedule; they say they close at 7, and at 5:54 they say they've already closed the till. The lady who works there is very rude and pedantic.

I really like how they treat my dog. It all depends on who bathes him. This girl who bathes him is always kind and gives him kisses. We always stay to watch them bathe him because vets and spas often stress them out. This isn't the case here, but we still like to watch. He always comes out super clean and fluffy. Every time we come, my dog ​​runs in for his bath! 😂 He loves the place, so 10/10. I have no bad experiences or negative comments.
Excellent service! I've been going all week because it's the only place that will rescue my dog's fur. Great attention and they treat you very well.
amazing place
When Kika needed to be put to sleep in an emergency, they helped us with an appointment and made her look beautiful for her farewell ceremony. We are very grateful.
Excellent place to bathe your dogs, they treat them very well

From the moment I made the appointment for the bath, everything went wrong. They gave me a day and time, and when I brought my pet in, it turned out he wasn't registered. They accepted him anyway after I showed them they'd made a mistake. When I went to pick him up, it took another 40 minutes just to get paid and hand my dog ​​back. They even put his harness on backwards. Finally, as I was leaving, they turned me away because they hadn't charged me for the toothbrush. I asked if I could get an invoice, and they said yes, that it was already being generated on their website. What they didn't tell me was that they invoice everything when they're closed on Sundays. The staff seems either uninterested or not properly trained. I won't be going back.
That's where I find the special food for my dogs, the Alphavet brand. It's an excellent food.
